Imported from the locally installed FamiStudio450-SoundEngine package.
Upstream: https://github.com/BleuBleu/FamiStudio
Documentation: https://famistudio.org/doc/soundengine/
The engine derives from FamiTone2 by Shiru; see its retained source header.

Hangar modification: configurable FAMISTUDIO_APU_BASE redirects the standard
APU registers to a 24-byte RAM shadow. No music code writes hardware directly.
Only standard NTSC note tables are included; PAL, DPCM and expansion audio
are disabled in this experiment. Source line endings normalized to LF.
This notice applies to the vendored engine and note tables, separately from
Hangar original code.

Experimental bank placement: optional FAMISTUDIO_CFG_BANKED_INIT places
init/music_stop/music_play/music_pause in the configured initialization
segment. Hangar calls these only at reset with NMI disabled. Playback,
sample_stop, pitch helpers and song data remain in the fixed bank.
No sequencer instructions or exported notes are changed by this relocation.
